products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and illustration application distributed under community governance. The foundation's website describes the project as oriented around free, open-source creative software, with no dependency on cloud services and with development and oversight handled by its community rather than by a commercial entity.

The foundation's AI-related offering is tracked as Krita AI, which extends the core Krita application through local AI plugins. Because processing runs locally rather than through a cloud service, users retain control over their data and workflows without requiring an external subscription or connection. The project's open-source nature means the plugins and underlying code are available for community inspection and contribution.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the available data for the Krita Foundation.
